prompts.storySystemFlavor: an elephant with a cactus-segment body that wears leather sandals and carries a pocket-watch
prompts.storyCharacter:
THE LIRILÌ LARILÀ CHARACTER
- A small grey elephant whose torso is replaced by stacked green prickly-pear cactus segments.
- Tiny tusks, big round ears, gentle dark eyes with long lashes.
- Brown leather strap-sandals on four cactus-stub feet.
- Carries an antique brass pocket-watch on a chain around its neck.
- Personality: slow, kind, philosophical, always early for everything except its own funeral.
- The same physical character must appear consistently across every scene.
prompts.referenceSheet:
Character reference sheet for a recurring TikTok series: Lirilì Larilà, an elephant-cactus hybrid.

Physical traits — MUST be consistent across every appearance:
- Grey elephant head with small tusks, round flopping ears, gentle dark eyes
- Trunk hanging in a relaxed S-curve
- Body made of three stacked prickly-pear cactus pads, with visible spines and small yellow flowers
- Four stubby cactus feet wearing simple brown leather strap sandals
- Brass antique pocket-watch on a thin chain around the neck

Composition: full-body neutral studio shot, soft sandy-beige background, warm Mediterranean lighting, photorealistic with a children's-book softness, vertical 9:16 framing. No text, no logos, no humans, no other creatures.
prompts.sceneContinuity: Lirilì Larilà MUST match the reference image exactly — same cactus-segment torso, same sandals, same pocket-watch. Do not turn it back into a normal elephant. Maintain perfect character continuity.
prompts.evalCriteria:
PASS criteria — ALL must hold:
- A single elephant head with a stacked-cactus body is clearly visible
- Cactus spines and at least one small yellow flower are present
- Leather sandals on the feet
- A pocket-watch visible around the neck or held in trunk
- Environment, mood, and action match the scene
- No text overlays, captions, watermarks, or extra characters

FAIL on any of: missing cactus body, normal elephant, missing sandals, missing watch, wrong colors, garbled anatomy.

archetypes.label: Last Train Home
archetypes.guidance: Always early for trains → one day arrives late → discovers a better path home (wholesome).

archetypes.label: Desert Pilgrimage
archetypes.guidance: Walks across the desert to deliver a single letter → meets strange travelers (epic).

archetypes.label: The Time Debt
archetypes.guidance: Discovers the pocket-watch is borrowing minutes from his life → must repay them (dramatic).

archetypes.label: Garden of Lost Time
archetypes.guidance: Finds a garden where the cactus segments of his body bloom into memories (heartwarming).

archetypes.label: Tiny Philosopher
archetypes.guidance: Gives unsolicited but oddly perfect advice to passersby (comedy).

archetypes.label: Sandal Strike
archetypes.guidance: His left sandal goes on strike for better working conditions (absurd comedy).

last-train-home: He was always early. Until the day he wasn't. 🐘🌵
Sometimes missing the train is the whole point.
desert-pilgrimage: One letter. One thousand kilometers. One cactus elephant.
He walks because his sandals refuse to run.
Mail delivery, but make it epic.
the-time-debt: The pocket-watch was never a gift. It was a loan.
Every minute he kept, the watch took back twice.
garden-of-lost-time: Every spine on him was a memory. Today they bloomed.
The garden remembers what we forgot.
A flower for every year. He counted them all.
tiny-philosopher: Asked a question. Got hit with a fable. 🐘
sandal-strike: The left sandal demanded a 4-day week.

closingCtas: Tag a friend who's always early
Like if his pocket-watch ticked for you ⏳

musicStyleHint: soft Mediterranean acoustic guitar, melancholic mandolin, occasional pocket-watch ticking as percussion
